change: Two evaluator checks made principled (criteria text unchanged): (1) @bundle_no_remote_outside_clerk now fails on remote RESOURCE references (HTML src/href, CSS url()/@import, JS fetch/import/WebSocket/new URL of an absolute external URL) outside the lazily loaded Clerk chunk, and merely records incidental URL strings (library comments/error-message docs); amendment 4's host allow-list is replaced by this rule. (2) @e2e_unusable_no_state relies on the deterministic final facts (7 unusable windows rendered, no RECHECK_SENSOR state change, observed monitoring-state sequence) and requires a transient UNUSABLE DOM frame in at least one of the two runs.
defect: The second dry evaluation failed criteria 45 and 59: (45) the DOM sampler coalesces frames in ACCELERATED mode, so run 1 did not catch a transient UNUSABLE frame even though the deterministic facts show 7 unusable windows; (59) a bundled three.js chunk carries URLs inside library comments (jcgt.org, reddit.com, ...), which are not requests - zero external requests were recorded in the browser for both runs.
